profile.headline: Hardware Video Encoder/Decoder Validation Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Video Codec Engineer with strong research, development, and optimization skills.  Extensive experiences in fast motion estimation, fast mode decision algorithms, and perceptual quality rate-control. 
•	Highly experienced in development and implementation of video encoders
•	Strengths include use of effective research and investigation methodology for digital image processing and video compression.

positions.title: Silicon Validation Software Engineer
positions.description:
- develop low-level software to validate functionality, conformance, and performance of video compression blocks
- bring-up and debug devices on new hardware platforms.

positions.title: Video Codec Algorithm Engineer
positions.description:
Research and Development of Video Pre-processing Technology
- Designed and Implemented Denoising Algorithms
- Analyzed how the spatial and temporal noise affects the subjective quality and bitrate

positions.title: Senior Video Codec Engineer
positions.description:
Research and development of Video Codecs.
- Designed and implemented Perceptual Quality Rate-Control to save bitrate while keeping the high subjective quality. 
- Played a key role in design and develop Spatial and Temporal Metrics for detecting the sensitive area for HUMAN eyes. 
- Researched and Design of Video Scene Phenomena such as a scene change, fade in/out, and dissolve. 
- Optimized Two-Pass Rate-Control Algorithms to improve Speed and Subjective Quality for Adaptive Bitrate Outputs.
- Improve Video Codec Performance in terms of Rate-Distortion and Speed.

positions.title: Video Codec Engineer
positions.description:
1. Research and Development for H.263, Mpeg4, H.264, and H.265 Video Encoder.

2. Development Fast Motion Estimation
- PMVFAST(Predictive Motion Vector Field Adaptive Search Technique)
- UMH(Uneven Multi-Hexagon Search)
- EPZS(Enhanced Predictive Zonal Search)

3. Research and Development for Fast Mode Decision
- Early Skip Mode Decision
- Efficient Intra mode Decision
- Fast Transform Size Decision for H.265
- Efficient Intra Skip Method.

4. Research Rate-Control
- VBR for file or stroage application
- CBR for streaming application

5. Developed  Pre-processing Filters, such as De-interlace, De-noise and Re-size Filter.

6. Determine speed optimization of the video algorithm based on TI DSP(64x+ and 66x core) architecture.

7. Design video encoder architecture based on multiple processors or multiple cores using assembly language for single core and multi-core DSP chipset architecture and optimization technique.

8. Parallel Processing for Video Encoder:
- Slice, Tile, and Frame based parallelization(or Threading)

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
- Development the video telephony system over Internet protocol.
- Optimization the video codec for Intel X-scale processor. 
- Research the fast motion estimation: PMVFAST(Predictive Motion Vector Field Adaptive Search Technique)

publications.title: Fast Coding Mode Selection With Rate-Distortion Optimization for MPEG-4 Part-10 AVC/H.264
publications.publisher: Circuits and Systems for Video Technology, IEEE Transactions, Vol. 16 · Dec 1, 2006

publications.title: Efficient coding mode decision in MPEG-4 part-10 AVC/H.264 main profile
